en.headline: Yellow work heat stress warning issued as heat persists
en.dek: The Labour Department raised the yellow warning at 10.10am, while the Observatory’s Very Hot Weather Warning remained in force.
body: The Labour Department issued a yellow work heat stress warning at 10.10am on Wednesday, saying heat stress in some workplaces was rather high.

The department reminded employers and employees to take precautions against heat stroke in hot weather or high-temperature settings. Workers outdoors or in indoor spaces without air-conditioning face higher heat stress, it said. Employers should assess risks, rearrange work periods where practicable, provide shade and ventilation, and allow rest and water.

The Hong Kong Observatory’s Very Hot Weather Warning, first issued at 11.15am on 28 September and updated this morning, remained in force. The Observatory’s nine-day forecast issued at 11.30am said Thursday would be very hot with some sunshine and a few showers later, with local thunderstorms possible. Temperatures were forecast at 29 to 33 degrees.
Employees who develop symptoms such as headache, dizziness, thirst or nausea should rest in a cool place, drink water and notify their supervisor, the Labour Department said.

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告生效 酷熱天氣警告持續
zh.dek: 勞工處星期三上午10時10分發出黃色工作暑熱警告；天文台酷熱天氣警告仍然生效。
body: 勞工處星期三上午10時10分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境的熱壓力頗高。
勞工處提醒僱主及僱員在酷熱天氣或高溫環境工作時採取防暑措施。戶外或沒有空調的室內工作熱壓力較高。僱主應評估風險，在切實可行情況下重新編排工作時段、提供遮蔭及通風，並安排休息及補充水分。
天文台酷熱天氣警告由9月28日上午11時15分發出，並於今早更新後仍然生效。天文台上午11時30分的九天天氣預報指，星期四部分時間有陽光，日間酷熱，稍後有幾陣驟雨，局部地區可能有雷暴，氣溫介乎29至33度。
勞工處表示，僱員如出現頭痛、頭暈、口渴或惡心等熱疾病徵狀，應立即到陰涼處休息及飲水，並通知僱主或主管。
